summary: Frontend-only verification of App Store Guideline 3.2 compliance edits on the static X-Ray Vault site (index.html, privacy.html, support.html). Verified complete removal of all 'Get the app' CTAs and store badges, presence of new hero CTA 'Explore features' -> #features, bottom CTA 'Talk to support' -> support.html, reworded personal-use copy, nav (Home/Privacy/Support only), footer Product column (Security/Support only), mobile hamburger toggle, and no residual links to removed features.html/screenshots.html. All 3 pages return HTTP 200 and render expected sections (5 feature rows, 7 phones in #screenshots) and support email is present.
critical_code_review_comments: Anchor scroll for #features lands ~80px before the section top (final=1870 vs features_top=1950). This is a minor UX offset (likely due to sticky header height not being accounted for in Lenis anchor offset). Acceptable, but consider adding scroll-margin-top or Lenis offset for section anchors.

privacy.html line 91 still mentions 'the app's support channel listed on its App Store page' as plain text - this is prose, not a CTA/button, and does not violate the change scope, but the user may want to reword to 'the app's support page' to be fully consistent with the removal of store references.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static 3-page marketing site verified against Guideline 3.2 compliance rewrite. All acceptance criteria met: (1) zero occurrences of 'Get the app' text, (2) zero App Store/Google Play badge images across all 3 pages, (3) hero-cta-secondary='Explore features' -> #features scrolls to Features (within ~80px), (4) cta-primary='Talk to support' -> support.html, (5) nav = Home/Privacy/Support on all pages (support.html keeps 'Contact us' nav-cta which is per spec), (6) footer Product col = Security/Support with no store block, (7) all reworded copy present ('your own radiography reference', '03 — YOUR NOTES', 'Protocols & Contacts You Build', 'Save your own protocol notes', 'Build your own contacts list', 'Built for the floor, not the reading room.', 'set up and managed entirely by you'), (8) no forbidden phrases on index.html, (9) support FAQ safety disclaimer intentionally kept, (10) no dead links to removed features.html/screenshots.html, (11) mobile nav-toggle opens/closes correctly (aria-expanded true/false), (12) 5 .frow rows and 7 phones in #screenshots render, (13) xrayvaultsupport@gmail.com present on support.html.
rca of the issue: N/A - all requested compliance changes verified as implemented correctly.
